replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Where can we submit kit.ymls? You can make a post in the "Map Releases" subforum if you'd like.
Where can we submit map.pngs? Package it with your map download or post it on github for us to add.
Are Itemspawners allowed/working? Yes, they work and are allowed!
Are scoreboxes still supported, like on the old Actrix map? Unfortunately, support for scoreboxes were dropped. No :( 
Separate yml for the tiering in SG? Nope.
Can a map be in the Nether or the End? No, we don't have a dimension module to make them go into nether/end. You can set the biome to it though.
How do the jump pads work? (in detail pls) Jump Pads are modules that let you go a certain velocity and verticity with a push module that belongs under triggers. For velocity, it is defined as "the speed of something in a given direction." We use that to define speed going specifically TOWARD a direction. Accompanied with velocity is "vertical". Vertical is defined as "a vertical line or plane." With that, using them together calls for a given movement sent by the region to move the player. All of this is umbrellaed under the regions: module and you can insert plenty of other triggers and flags and events with it, for more customization. Keep in mind a jump pad doesn't necessarily have to be a pad; it could be a global flag and you could hop everywhere. It could be a cuboid or sphere or point or cylinder, anything your heart calls for. The usage for this, as shown by an example by me:

And are you excited for more questions? Sure!

replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
I am not a map developer, but I guess I can still assist to some extent...

No need to worry about the colours, the server does it automatically; according to your team colours!

To put an enchantment on an item, it would look something like this;

item: bow
enchants:
- arrow_infinite:1

The ID for enchantments is confusing, but just google the enchantment IDs :p
The numeral next to the enchantment specifies the level. In the example above, it would be Infinite 1. Of course, Infinite 2 is just stupid :p

EG:
For power 2 bow;

enchants:
- arrow_damage:2

replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body: I'm pretty sure you can't keep your items after dying, at least with the current YAML modules. You can prevent TNT griefing by using the entity_explosion_damage flag in the region that you want to protect. You can disable void building by using void-build: false as a separate module in the YAML. Keep in mind, though, that void-build cannot be used as a flag. Also, using that module would prevent void building in the entire map.
